# Fried Schölvinck

> Personal website of Fried Schölvinck, an AI engineer in Amsterdam and founder of Coldfinch.

Fried works on production AI systems, generative AI, agentic applications, data engineering and custom software. He works at Xomnia and runs Coldfinch, a Dutch company providing managed open-source software and custom business applications.

## Main pages

- [Home and selected work](https://friett.github.io/): Biography, skills, projects and writing.
- [Coldfinch](https://coldfinch.eu/): Managed open-source and custom software company founded by Fried.
- [Momberger Airport Information](https://momberger.app/): B2B airport intelligence platform built by Coldfinch.
- [Huib Luns](https://huibluns.nl/): Digital art archive built by Coldfinch.
